official.deadline_note: January semester applications run 25/08 to 20/10/2026 with results notified by email in late November 2026; the September semester window (15/04 to 15/07/2026) has closed.
official.status_note: TDTU publishes the January semester application period as open from 25/08 to 20/10/2026.
official.tuition_coverage_note: Full scholarship: 100% tuition fee for the undergraduate programme (not including tuition for courses studied for the second time). Partial scholarship: 50-75% tuition fee for the undergraduate programme (same exclusion).
benefits: Full scholarship: 100% undergraduate tuition fee and 100% dormitory fee
Partial scholarship: 50-75% undergraduate tuition fee and 100% dormitory fee
Vietnamese-taught programmes: 100% of the Vietnamese language class tuition fee under both scholarship types
Monthly living allowance scholarships at the Khanh Hoa branch (Vietnamese-taught programmes): 5 full awards of VND 4,000,000 per month and 20 partial awards of VND 2,500,000 per month
eligibility: High school diploma or equivalent with graduation time in 2027, 2026 or 2025
Average high school study GPA or average high school graduation exam GPA of at least 5.0/10
English-taught programmes: citizen of an English-native-speaking country, or a valid IELTS of at least 5.5 (or an accepted equivalent certificate)

Vietnamese-taught programmes: Vietnamese language proficiency test result/certificate at B2 level or above, or one year of Vietnamese language study at TDTU followed by passing TDTU's Vietnamese proficiency test at B2 or above
Pharmacy major: final-year senior high school GPA marked 'Good' or above and an average Chemistry score of at least 7.0/10.0
Architecture, Graphic Design, Interior Design, Fashion Design and Industrial Design: TDTU aptitude assessment test required before entering the Bachelor's programme
requirements: Be officially admitted by Ton Duc Thang University and satisfy all scholarship maintenance requirements throughout your studies
Send scanned copies of required documents to admission.undergraduate@tdtu.edu.vn within the application period; an application is valid only when sufficient and correct documents are submitted
The International Admission Council selects the applicants with the highest academic performances
Renewal each academic year requires a previous-year GPA not below 6.0 (English-taught) or not below 5.0 plus passing the Vietnamese proficiency language class at B2 (Vietnamese-taught)

Applicants from Myanmar: the high school transcript is strictly required; the matriculation examination result is accepted only with a confirmation form signed and stamped by the local authority or Department of Education
documents: High school diploma or equivalent, or the high school transcript (strictly required for applicants from Myanmar)
High school study transcript or graduation exam result showing an average of at least 5.0/10
IELTS certificate of at least 5.5 or an accepted equivalent for English-taught programmes, or proof of citizenship of an English-native-speaking country
Vietnamese language proficiency certificate at B2 level or above, or the TDTU Vietnamese proficiency test result for Vietnamese-taught programmes
TDTU aptitude assessment test result for Architecture, Graphic Design, Interior Design, Fashion Design and Industrial Design
Matriculation confirmation form signed and stamped by the local authority or Department of Education, where a matriculation result is used instead of a high school transcript
Scanned copies of all required documents sent to admission.undergraduate@tdtu.edu.vn
selection_criteria: The International Admission Council selects applicants with the highest academic performances
The type of scholarship (partial or full) depends on the applicant's academic performance and language proficiency performance
The scholarship is reviewed annually based on the student's academic performance in accordance with the University's regulations
coverage: Full scholarship: 100% undergraduate tuition fee (excluding courses studied for a second time) and 100% dormitory fee
Partial scholarship: 50-75% undergraduate tuition fee and 100% dormitory fee
Vietnamese-taught programmes: 100% of the Vietnamese language class tuition fee (excluding a repeat of that class)
Khanh Hoa branch monthly living allowances: VND 4,000,000 per month (5 full awards) and VND 2,500,000 per month (20 partial awards)
application_method: Follow the TDTU undergraduate admissions timeline for the target semester
Prepare the documents listed on the university's application form and documents page
Send scanned copies to admission.undergraduate@tdtu.edu.vn within the application period
Await the result notified by email (late November for the January 2027 semester) and respond within 14 days
official.application_route: Email the scanned application document set to admission.undergraduate@tdtu.edu.vn within the published window for the target semester
official.citizenship_residency: Open to international applicants; the page does not restrict nationality
official.subject_or_agency_requirement: 11 English-taught undergraduate majors, or 51 Vietnamese-taught majors (Vietnamese Studies - Vietnamese Language, Culture & Society excluded); Pharmacy, Architecture, Graphic Design, Interior Design, Fashion Design and Industrial Design carry additional requirements
official.duration: 04-05 years for English-taught programmes according to major; 01 compulsory year of Vietnamese language followed by 04-05 years for Vietnamese-taught programmes
official.description: Ton Duc Thang University offers international undergraduate applicants partial to full scholarships for the 2026-2027 academic year, with the award level depending on academic performance and language proficiency: full awards cover 100% of the undergraduate tuition fee and 100% of the dormitory fee, while partial awards cover 50-75% of tuition plus the full dormitory fee.
official.program_type: University-funded admission scholarship (tuition and dormitory fee waiver)
official.english_requirement: English-taught programmes: citizen of an English-native-speaking country, or a valid IELTS of at least 5.5 (or accepted equivalent); Vietnamese-taught programmes: Vietnamese proficiency at B2 level or above

verification.notes: Verified on TDTU's official scholarship page: the full/partial structure and dormitory coverage, Khanh Hoa allowance tiers, the January semester window 25/08-20/10/2026, retention criteria and the 14-day response rule. The award is published as a percentage of fees rather than a single monetary amount, so funding_amount stays null; the page states a 5.0/10 average in its general eligibility section and an 8.0/10 average in the English-taught inclusions note.

applicant_utility.summary: TDTU's scholarship is percentage-based, so whether you receive 50-75% or 100% of tuition (plus a free dormitory place) depends on your grades and language scores as ranked by the International Admission Council. The live page is internally inconsistent about the academic bar: the eligibility section cites a 5.0/10 average while the English-taught inclusions note cites 8.0/10, so aim as high as possible and confirm with the admissions email. Apply early in the 25 August - 20 October 2026 window, because results arrive by email in late November and the offer lapses if you do not respond within 14 days.
applicant_utility.best_fit: Recent high school graduates (2025-2027) with strong averages applying to TDTU's English- or Vietnamese-taught bachelor programmes, especially design, architecture and Pharmacy applicants who can meet the extra entry tests.
application_readiness_checklist: Maximise and verify your high school average against both published thresholds (5.0/10 in eligibility, 8.0/10 in the English-taught note) and query the discrepancy with admissions
Book the TDTU aptitude assessment test early if applying to Architecture, Graphic Design, Interior Design, Fashion Design or Industrial Design
Prepare IELTS 5.5 or an accepted equivalent, or proof of English-native citizenship, for English-taught programmes
For Vietnamese-taught programmes, prepare a B2 Vietnamese certificate or plan for the compulsory one-year language year
For Pharmacy, verify a final-year Chemistry average of at least 7.0/10 and a 'Good' final-year GPA
Myanmar applicants: obtain the high school transcript and any stamped matriculation confirmation form
Email the complete scanned document set early to admission.undergraduate@tdtu.edu.vn and diarise the 14-day reply window after the late-November result
common_rejection_risks: Incomplete or incorrect document sets, which TDTU states make an application invalid
Missing the 14-day response window after the result email, which terminates the scholarship and transfers it to other applicants
Falling below the retention GPA (6.0 for English-taught; 5.0 plus a B2 pass for Vietnamese-taught)
Applying to design or architecture majors without the aptitude assessment test
Myanmar applicants submitting a matriculation result without the required transcript or the stamped confirmation form
applicant_utility.estimated_uncovered_costs: Under a partial award, the remaining 25-50% of tuition; for all awardees, meals, transport, personal and living costs beyond the dormitory, insurance and visa costs, plus any repeated-course tuition which is excluded from coverage
document_audit: Only scanned copies sent by email are described; there is no online portal submission on the page
The matriculation confirmation form must be signed and stamped by the local authority or Department of Education
Vietnamese language class tuition is covered only once; repeating the class is not covered
Tuition for courses studied for a second time is explicitly excluded from both scholarship types
alerts: The page publishes two different academic thresholds (5.0/10 in the eligibility section, 8.0/10 in the English-taught inclusions note); verify before relying on either
January semester results arrive in late November and lapse after 14 days of no response
Only 25 monthly living allowances exist (5 full and 20 partial) and only for Vietnamese-taught study at the Khanh Hoa branch
applicant_utility.submission_workflow: Email the scanned document set within the application window, TDTU's International Admission Council ranks academic performance, eligible applicants are notified by email in late November and must respond within 14 days.
